adapters.purpose: Stores landing-page batches in process memory so tests can run the same contract as ClickHouse.
adapters.data: The current row for each batch, queue claim, analysis, and dataset key. The latest write wins.

adapters.purpose: Stores schema-2 batches in process memory so tests can run the same contract as ClickHouse.
adapters.data: The current row for each schema-2 key. The latest write wins, and claims expire the same way they do in ClickHouse.
